- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G4.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G4.json) — Recorded generation G4 where the software dimension is scored from git history; no provider contacted. · **Use:** Fifth measurement point in the generation series.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G5.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G5.json) — Recorded generation G5 with dimensions gated by the evidence-reuse guard. · **Use:** Sixth measurement point in the generation series.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G6.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/generations/G6.json) — Recorded generation G6 using the same readings as G5 but restricting which enter the headline mean, with an alternate mean including carried readings. · **Use:** Latest recorded generation in the Omega series.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/holdout-manifest.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/holdout-manifest.json) — Manifest of a sealed holdout corpus storing answers as salted digests, with counts and a corpus digest. · **Use:** Verify holdouts were committed before scoring and not returned for sealed tasks.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/meta-improvement.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/meta-improvement.json) — Episodes of meta-improvement attempts (saturation, coverage, consistency-not-capability) with statuses such as moved-elsewhere, persisted, resolved. · **Use:** Track whether fixes to the evaluator actually removed the symptom.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/reality-connection.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/reality-connection.json) — Sealed forecasts, closed and voided reality loops and calibration summaries scored against observer contracts, with a repository-local calibration verdict. · **Use:** Evidence on how well sealed forecasts matched later observation.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/refutations.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/refutations.json) — Recorded refutations of earlier NULLSTAR claims under a stated law. · **Use:** Keep self-corrections discoverable alongside the claims they overturn.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/suite-retirement.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/suite-retirement.json) — Retires an evaluation suite, lists contaminated generations and the trivial-baseline score, and states what is preserved and not claimed. · **Use:** Explain why earlier generation scores are not comparable to later ones.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-omega/velocity.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-omega/velocity.json) — Computed improvement velocity across recorded generations with pairwise deltas, trend, and an acceleration claim governed by a law. · **Use:** Check whether any acceleration claim is supported by the data.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/attribution-audit.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/attribution-audit.json) — Hand-built probes comparing two implementations to see whether they differ where it matters; explicitly not a capability measurement. · **Use:** Check attribution of a result to a specific solver implementation.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/baselines-v2.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/baselines-v2.json) — Second baseline set with seeds, scores, cost, instrument validity and a ceiling warning; partial with named blockers. · **Use:** Baseline margins for the terminal evaluation epoch.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/branch-debt.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/branch-debt.json) — Counts remote branches, diverged branches, merged-then-reverted work and stranded files, with disposition. · **Use:** Size the unreconciled branch lineage before closing NULLSTAR.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/branch-dispositions.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/branch-dispositions.json) — Per-branch terminal dispositions and open pull requests, including UBER/OS and NULLSTAR reconciliation PRs, with terminal and non-terminal counts. · **Use:** Decide what remains to reconcile and what needs a founder decision.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/completion-debt.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/completion-debt.json) — Computed ledger of open software and external work items, failure debt, permanent limitations and a done verdict with reasons it is not done. · **Use:** Single honest list of what remains before NULLSTAR can be called done.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/cross-organ-transfer.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/cross-organ-transfer.json) — Tests whether a mechanism transfers to a receiving organ on constructed tasks, with baseline, mechanism and code transfer counts. · **Use:** Evidence on cross-organ transfer and its stated limits.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/failure-debt.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/failure-debt.json) — Compiled records of failures from NULLSTAR missions (reality connection, baselines) with open ids and a governing law. · **Use:** Track unresolved failures against the terminal report.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/final-report.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/final-report.json) — Terminal report of generations, current capability, out-of-pattern standing, corrections against own results, evidence index and permanent limitations, all figures computed. · **Use:** Final NULLSTAR summary of what was measured and what it is not.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-ablation.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-ablation.json) — Ablation comparing promoted and ablated solvers on disjoint seeds plus an out-of-range probe to see if the instrument separates them. · **Use:** Check whether the GA1 win reflects a real difference.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-declaration.json) — Pre-committed GA1 declaration: bottleneck, hypotheses, candidate families and criteria for the first capability-targeting generation. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA1 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga1-result.json) — GA1 tournament result: incumbent, candidates, winner, outcome, discrimination and ties against a precommitted threshold. · **Use:** Record the GA1 outcome and its stated limits.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-ablation.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-ablation.json) — Ablation of the GA2 promoted solver on disjoint seeds to see what the instrument can separate. · **Use:** Check the GA2 win against an ablated solver.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-declaration.json) — Pre-committed GA2 declaration recomputing the bottleneck after GA1 promotion, before any candidate existed. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA2 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga2-result.json) — GA2 tournament result with incumbent, candidates, regression disqualifications, winner and tie-break. · **Use:** Record the GA2 outcome.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-ablation.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-ablation.json) — GA3 ablation including whether a null candidate was in the tournament, and an instrument weakness found. · **Use:** Check the GA3 win and instrument weakness.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-declaration.json) — Pre-committed GA3 declaration with instrument precondition, hypotheses, criteria and what it cannot establish, carrying a correction from finding F010. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA3 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga3-result.json) — GA3 tournament result with incumbent, candidates, winner, discrimination and ties at top. · **Use:** Record the GA3 outcome, later refuted by generalization V2.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga4-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga4-declaration.json) — GA4 declaration re-attacking the invention family under the out-of-pattern gate after generalization V2 refuted GA3's promotion. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA4 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga4-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga4-result.json) — GA4 tournament result including out-of-pattern gate and candidates disqualified by it. · **Use:** Record the GA4 outcome.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga5-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga5-declaration.json) — GA5 declaration re-running the invention family with the operator-position defect repaired, on unread held-out seeds. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA5 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga5-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga5-result.json) — GA5 tournament result with out-of-pattern gate, ties and winner. · **Use:** Record the GA5 outcome.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga6-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga6-declaration.json) — GA6 declaration re-running GA5 under a comparison rule that sees both numbers after a gate-failing incumbent held on via a tie. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA6 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga6-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga6-result.json) — GA6 tournament result with the new comparison rule, gate disqualifications and winner. · **Use:** Record the GA6 outcome.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga7-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga7-declaration.json) — GA7 declaration attacking three-quantity composition at difficulty 4 where the promoted solver confabulates on every item. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA7 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga7-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga7-result.json) — GA7 tournament result with comparison rule, gate and winner. · **Use:** Record the GA7 outcome.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga8-declaration.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga8-declaration.json) — GA8 declaration attacking right-grouped compositions at difficulty 5 where the promoted solver answers wrongly on every item. · **Use:** Pre-registration for the GA8 tournament.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga8-result.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/ga8-result.json) — GA8 tournament result including a differential check, gate and winner. · **Use:** Record the GA8 outcome, the last generation of the series.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/generalization-v2.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/generalization-v2.json) — Supersedes the first generalization test: three solvers against one instrument plus hand-built items, with a headline finding. · **Use:** Evidence that GA3's promotion did not generalize.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/meta-improvement-v2.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/meta-improvement-v2.json) — Changes a selection criterion after finding a defect and backtests it against one generation; names the runner-up counterfactual. · **Use:** Record the corrected meta-improvement selection rule.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/probe-saturation.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/probe-saturation.json) — Enumerates a finite prompt grammar against one solver, counting confabulations and refusals to bound its behavior. · **Use:** Bound how a solver behaves over one finite space of prompts.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/stranded-absent-determinations.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/stranded-absent-determinations.json) — Determinations about stranded source files found absent from main, with method and reasoning for each. · **Use:** Resolve branch debt items for files that did not carry over.
- [`artifacts/nullstar-terminal/stranded-supersession.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar-terminal/stranded-supersession.json) — Large per-module table mapping stranded source modules to evidence of supersession by name match on main, with evidence classes and counts. · **Use:** Show which stranded modules have a successor on main.
- [`artifacts/nullstar/directive-reconciliation.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar/directive-reconciliation.json) — Row-by-row reconciliation of the founder NULLSTAR directive sections against repository evidence, with a cut set and row digest. · **Use:** Show which directive sections are covered, partial or missing in the repo.
- [`artifacts/nullstar/terminal-declarations.json`](../../artifacts/nullstar/terminal-declarations.json) — Reviewed name mappings that alias directive sections to modules, with terminal declarations and milestone receipts. · **Use:** Map directive sections to code without granting authority.
- [`artifacts/project-nullstar-directive.json`](../../artifacts/project-nullstar-directive.json) — Structured import of the PROJECT NULLSTAR founder directive: sections like prime directive and repository archaeology, provenance, corpus digest. · **Use:** machine-readable source of NULLSTAR directive sections
